summary: Defines shared LocalEndpointConfig struct in internal/api/types.go with URL, SecretKey, TLSInsecureSkipVerify fields and Validate(prefix) method. Embeds it as LocalEndpoint field in metrics.Config, logfwd.Config, and auditfwd.Config. Each pipeline's Validate() delegates to LocalEndpoint.Validate() with correct prefix, only when Enabled=true. Config redaction of secret_key leveraged from existing regex in up.go. Comprehensive unit tests (6 for LocalEndpointConfig, 4 per pipeline, 5 for redaction). Documentation updated in configuration.md and all three observability reference docs.

tests_checklist.item: V1: All tests pass (go test ./... — 24 packages OK)
LocalEndpointConfig has 6 unit tests covering zero value, valid HTTPS, reject HTTP, reject malformed URL, require SecretKey, accept orphaned SecretKey
Each pipeline config has 4 tests: valid local endpoint, invalid URL, missing SecretKey, disabled skips validation
Redaction test (TestRedactSensitiveLine_SecretKey) has 5 sub-tests verifying secret_key redacted and url/tls_insecure_skip_verify not redacted
TE1: Happy paths tested with realistic data (valid HTTPS URLs with ports and paths)
TE2: Edge cases covered (zero value, malformed URL, orphaned SecretKey without URL)
TE3: Error cases tested (HTTP scheme, missing SecretKey, malformed URL)
TE4: Tests are independent (no shared mutable state)
TE7: Assertions are specific (check exact error substrings, not just non-nil)
No existing tests broken by changes

code_quality_checklist.item: V2: go vet passes on all affected packages
V3: golangci-lint passes on all affected packages (zero output)
Q1: LocalEndpointConfig.Validate does one thing — validate the local endpoint config
Q2: Validate method is 15 lines — well within limits
Q3: No code duplication — struct defined once, embedded in three configs
Q4: Clear naming (LocalEndpointConfig, Validate, URL, SecretKey, TLSInsecureSkipVerify)
Q5: No deep nesting — early returns throughout
Q7: No dead code or commented-out code
P1: Follows existing patterns (same Validate() signature, same error message format, same yaml tags)
P5: File locations match project structure conventions (types in api/types.go, config in pkg/config.go)

security_checklist.item: S1: URL validated at config boundary (scheme, host presence, parsability)
S3: No hardcoded secrets — SecretKey is a reference, not a literal credential
S5: Sensitive data not exposed — secret_key automatically redacted in config dumps via existing regex
URL scheme enforced as HTTPS — prevents accidental plaintext transmission

architecture_checklist.item: C1: Implements exactly what was requested — shared type, embedding, validation, tests, docs
C2: All acceptance criteria met (6 user stories, 6 tasks all done)
C3: Edge cases handled (zero value, empty URL, malformed URL, orphaned SecretKey)
C4: Errors raised explicitly with descriptive messages including prefix
C5: No regression — full test suite passes
Single struct definition shared across three pipelines (DRY)
Minimal change footprint — only adds code, no refactoring of existing logic

dry_yagni_checklist.item: LocalEndpointConfig defined exactly once in internal/api/types.go
No duplicate validation logic — all three pipelines delegate to shared Validate()
No YAGNI violations — no unused fields, no over-engineering, no future-proofing
Leverages existing redaction logic in up.go rather than adding new redaction code

fail_fast_checklist.item: URL validation fails fast at config load time, not at runtime
SecretKey requirement enforced at startup, preventing unauthenticated runtime connections
Validation skipped when Enabled=false (correct — no point validating disabled config)

defensive_checklist.item: URL parsed and validated (scheme, host presence)
SecretKey required when URL is set (prevents accidental unauthenticated endpoint)
Zero-valued config treated as 'not configured' — safe default

suggested_improvements: Minor: Pipeline config tests (4 per pipeline x 3 = 12) are structurally identical — could consider a shared test helper in a future refactor, but current duplication is acceptable for 4 tests per package and avoids cross-package test dependencies
next_steps: L002: Wire LocalEndpointConfig into pipeline runtime to actually send data to the local endpoint
